caption: The drawing features a single, centrally positioned object that resembles a mechanical or industrial tool, possibly a valve or clamp. This object is rendered in shades of brown and dark gray, giving it a metallic and somewhat worn appearance. The tool consists of interlocking and curved components, including a screw mechanism and grooved surfaces. The object is vertically oriented, with the upper part featuring a handle-like structure, the middle portion displaying circular and coiled elements, and the base ending in a flat, toothed section. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements present. Near the bottom right of the object, the name "Frank McEntee" is written in small, simple, grayish letters. The overall composition is minimalist, with substantial empty space surrounding the central object.
title: Sewing Bird
